title: 第1章 城隍寿诞-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “小姜，明天就是咱们老祖宗城隍爷的寿诞，晚上早点睡，别明儿一早赖床起不来。”

    “知道了，爷爷。”吴姜随口应道。

    打小他就听爷爷念叨，自家老祖宗当年做官时勤政爱民，死后被乡民请封，成了苍名县的县城隍。

    这话吴姜压根不信，别说他了，就连他爸老吴也不信，可爷爷总能振振有词地反驳：“你们别不信，要不是祖宗庇佑，咱们家代代单传，哪能顺顺当当传到现在？”

    听见这话，吴姜心里更想吐槽了：要是真有祖宗保佑，那不是应该让家族开枝散叶、人丁兴旺才对？亏得老爷子还是教了一辈子书的老教师，小学生都明白的道理，他却想不明白。

    不过眼下，刚大学毕业回了老家、工作还没着落的吴姜，可没心思跟爷爷掰扯这点小事。

    他还指望着哄得老头子高兴，能够混点零花钱花花，谁让他是老吴家十八代单传的独苗，老吴那儿不好啃，自然只能啃老老吴了。

    吴姜的父母都在省城打拼，平时回老家的机会也不多，吴姜这次回来，就是想陪陪这倔老头。之前老吴再三请老爷子去省城生活，可老头儿性格死倔，怎么都不挪窝，别人怎么劝都不听，只好让同在县里生活的大姑一家，勤来看看了。

    大姑算是继承了父业，和大姑父同在县高中里教书，大姑父还是老爷子教过的学生。

    老爷子吩咐完孙子，便不再管瘫在沙发上玩手机的吴姜，转身去准备明天上香要用的东西去了。

    吴姜躺在沙发上，吹着空调，拿着手机，正跟大学宿舍里那三个“义子”在群里侃大山。

    大郎：“哥几个，工作都找到没有？爸爸我明天就要去银行报到了。（龇牙笑）”

    二愣子：“靠！你个狗东西故意来炫耀的是吧？等见面哥几个非得捶爆你丫的！（锤子敲头）”

    三狗子：“老大进银行了，那不就是跟进了自己家一样嘛，要不要给哥几个每人发点？反正银行的钱也花不完。（坏笑）”

    四蛋子：“郎哥，卡号发你了，不用多，一人一个W就行，多了怕你扛不住事儿。（坏笑）”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

"Xiao Jiang, tomorrow is the birthday of our ancestor Cheng Huang. Go to bed early at night and don't stay in bed early tomorrow morning."

"I know, grandpa." Wu Jiang responded casually.

Since he was a child, he has heard his grandfather say that his ancestor worked diligently and loved the people when he was an official. After his death, he was invited by the villagers to become the county god of Cangming County.

Wu Jiang didn’t believe this at all, let alone his father, Old Wu, but his grandfather could always retort plausibly: “Don’t believe it. If it weren’t for the blessing of our ancestors, how could our family pass it down smoothly from generation to generation?”

Hearing this, Wu Jiang wanted to complain even more: If there is really blessing from the ancestors, shouldn't the family be able to flourish and prosper?Fortunately, the old man is still an old teacher who has been teaching all his life. Even elementary school students understand the truth, but he can't understand it.

But now, Wu Jiang, who has just graduated from college and returned to his hometown and has not yet found a job, has no intention of having to deal with such a trivial matter with his grandfather.

He also hoped to make the old man happy so that he could make some pocket money to spend. But he was the only child of the eighteenth generation of the Old Wu family. It was not easy for Old Wu to take advantage of him, so naturally he could only take advantage of Old Wu.

Wu Jiang’s parents are working hard in the provincial capital, and there are not many opportunities to return to their hometown. Wu Jiang came back this time just to accompany this stubborn old man.Old Wu had repeatedly invited the old man to live in the provincial capital, but the old man was stubborn and refused to move. He refused to listen to others' advice, so he had to ask his aunt and his family, who also lived in the county, to come and have a look.

The eldest aunt has inherited her father's business and teaches in the county high school with her eldest uncle. The eldest uncle is still a student taught by the old man.

After the old man gave his instructions to his grandson, he stopped caring about Wu Jiang, who was lying on the sofa playing with his mobile phone, and turned around to prepare the things he would use to burn incense tomorrow.

Wu Jiang was lying on the sofa, blowing on the air conditioner, holding her mobile phone, and chatting in the group with the three "adopted sons" in the university dormitory.

Dalang: "Brothers, have you found any jobs? Dad, I will go to the bank to report tomorrow. (Grinds smile)"

Second fool: "Damn! You are here to show off, you piece of shit, right? When we meet, I'll have to pound your ass off! (Knock on the head with a hammer)"

Sangouzi: "The boss has entered the bank. Isn't that just like following his own family? Do you want to give some to each of the brothers? The bank's money can't be spent anyway. (Smirk)"

Sidanzi: "Brother Lang, I've sent you a card number. You don't need more, just one W for each person. If there are more, I'm afraid you won't be able to handle the situation. (bad smile)"
